L2t: John B. Goodenough, co-inventor of the lithium-ion battery, received many honours from scientific bodies for his work on cathode materials.
L3t: The Royal Society elected Goodenough as a Foreign Member in the same year that the 2010s began, not in the 1990s or after his 2019 Nobel Prize.
L4t: Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010.
L2f: John B. Goodenough was born in Germany and spent his whole career at a single British university before moving into battery research.
L3f: The Royal Society elected Goodenough as a Foreign Member shortly after the lithium-ion battery cathode breakthrough, in the early 1990s, well before the Nobel Prize.
L4f: Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 1992.
